name: Adrienne
assistantMessage: Ophelia approves this message. Payment in cuddles is now due. 🐾
compliments: Your smile is a very good reason to lose my train of thought.
My memory might be chrome-dome territory. You are the part I keep coming back to.
Your book boyfriend could never send you this many forehead kisses.
You look especially adorable when you outsmart me.
An entire galaxy, and I’m still most interested in sitting next to you.
Grogu is adorable. You still win. I’m prepared to defend this opinion before the entire galaxy.
Grogu, Disney magic, and you beside me. That sounds like a pretty good little universe.
We went stargazing. I got distracted by your eyes. I’d make the same mistake again.

questions.title: Which kind of movie night?
replies: The Little Mermaid gets first pick. Then Hercules, Tangled, or Frozen 2. Your choice, my favorite company.
Ratatouille, Monsters, Inc., or Toy Story. You pick; I’ll find a spot beside you.
High School Musical, Descendants, or Starstruck. Consider this my application to be your movie-night duet partner.
Grogu, the droids, Vader, and Maul. That’s a pretty great lineup. I’m mostly here for your commentary.

questions.title: What kind of love note finds you today?
replies: You deserve a gentle day and someone who is happy to hear from you.
I made an entire website because apparently ‘hey, you’re cute’ needed a dramatic upgrade.
I was going to say something smooth, but then I imagined your smile and forgot my lines.

questions.title: Our imaginary front-row seats?
replies: A Bruno Mars night with you? Very easy to picture.
Ariana on stage, you beside me. That sounds like a pretty lovely evening.
Harry Styles, a room full of songs, and my favorite company.
Luke Combs, you close, and a song to sway to. I like that thought.

poem: I know I forget a lot of things,
We went out to look at the stars,
and I kept looking at your eyes.
I know you’ve given a lot of love
and haven’t always got it back.
I wish I had the right words for that.
I just know you deserved better.
I like getting to know you,
even the little things you think don’t matter.
I want to keep showing up for you
and make you smile whenever I can.
So this is just because, HoneyBunny.
No big reason. I was thinking of you.
I don’t always know how to say it,
but you mean a whole lot to me.
poemAfterword: You deserve to receive the same tenderness you give. I hope the little things I do help you feel that.

notes.label: OPEN WHEN
notes.title: You need a soft place
notes.teaser: A little reminder, tucked away for you.
body: HoneyBunny, you deserve care on the ordinary days, too. You don't have to do something extraordinary to deserve a gentle word, a listening ear, or a forehead kiss.
Thank you for letting me get to know you, one little piece at a time. I like the person I'm finding. A lot.

notes.label: ACROSS THE GALAXY
notes.title: Your little smile crew
notes.teaser: A few familiar faces, just for you.
body: Grogu and the whole droid crew are on smile duty: R2-D2, C-3PO, BB-8, Chopper, K-2SO, BD-1, D-O, and every little droid in between.
Vader and Maul can keep things dramatic. I’m here for the quiet moments beside you and the forehead kisses.
Ophelia has cuddles covered. I’d still like a spot next to you.

notes.label: BETWEEN THE PAGES
notes.title: A little competition
notes.teaser: Your book boyfriend should be nervous.
body: Your book boyfriend has competition. I come with actual hugs, terrible jokes, and the ability to distract you from the page with one well-timed kiss.
I'll let you finish the chapter, HoneyBunny. Probably.
